title: NyxHeads
description: NyxHeads is a Paper plugin that lets players steal lives by collecting the heads of players they kill, with banned players only able to return when their head is placed to revive them.
body:
# 💀 NyxHeads

A hardcore-style revival system for Paper servers where player lives are tied directly to their heads.

## ⚔️ Features

### 🗡️ Player Kill System

Only player-versus-player kills count.

If a player is killed by another player:

* 💀 The victim's player head drops.
* 🔨 The victim is instantly banned.
* 🎒 The killer can collect and carry the head.

The following do **NOT** trigger the system:

* Fall damage
* Lava
* Fire
* Drowning
* Suffocation
* Void damage
* TNT
* Creepers
* Mobs
* Environmental damage
* Commands
* Any non-player death source

### ❤️ Revival System

Every dropped head is linked to the player who died.

When a revival head is placed:

* ✨ The head is consumed.
* 🔓 The banned player is automatically unbanned.
* ⚡ The player is revived instantly.
* 📍 The player is teleported to the exact location where the head was placed.

### 🛡️ Head Protection

Revival heads are protected from storage and abuse.

Heads cannot be placed inside:

* Ender Chests
* Chests
* Trapped Chests
* Barrels
* Shulker Boxes
* Hoppers
* Droppers
* Dispensers
* Furnaces
* Bundles
* Item Frames
* Glow Item Frames
* Container Minecarts
* Any other storage container

Heads may only:

* 🎒 Exist in a player's inventory
* 📦 Exist as a dropped item
* ❤️ Be placed for revival

### ⚙️ Administration

Commands:

* `/nyxheads`
* `/nyxheads reload`
* `/nyxheads status`
* `/nyxheads headsplugin enable`
* `/nyxheads headsplugin disable`
* `/nyxheads revive <player>`
* `/nyxheads unban <player>`

### 🔑 Permissions

* `nyxheads.admin`
* `nyxheads.reload`
* `nyxheads.revive`
* `nyxheads.unban`

### 🔧 Configuration

Configurable options include:

* Plugin enable/disable
* Death broadcasts
* Revival broadcasts
* Save intervals
* Custom messages

Supports MiniMessage formatting.

### 📦 Compatibility

* Paper 1.21.x
* Java 21

### 📝 Notes

* 💾 Data persists through server restarts.
* 🎭 Revival heads are tied to specific players.
* 🔒 Designed to prevent duplication glitches and storage exploits.
* 🌎 Perfect for SMPs, Hardcore, Factions, and PvP-focused servers.

## 🔥 Bring real consequences to PvP and make every head matter.

Created By Jesterlol_
